name_reason: The '_y_' infix is a misnomer: this single accumulator is shared by all four walk-step directions and carries the X byte-offset during left/right steps (fd2_walk_step_left += -4, fd2_walk_step_right += +4) just as it carries the Y offset for up/down (+/- 0x720). fd2_composite_battle_tile_map reads it as a flat (unscaled) byte offset added to the background-blit source pointer regardless of axis, so there is nothing Y-specific about it. The existing Ghidra plate already flags '_y_' as a misnomer and notes 'Rename pending Stage 2'. Drop '_y_' to reflect the single-axis-agnostic role. Recorded only; not applied (Stage 2 sequenced rename touches globals.h + all call sites).
purpose: Cumulative sub-pixel byte-offset accumulator for the smooth 6-frame walk-step slide; one global serves whichever axis (X or Y) is currently stepping, added unscaled into the battle tile-map background-blit source offset.
logic_summary: Zero-initialized BSS scalar. Each of fd2_walk_step_down/up/left/right adds its per-frame scroll delta into it once per slide frame (6 frames) then resets it to 0 at step end (so the static, non-animating image always reads 0). Per-frame deltas: down +0x720 / up -0x720 (vertical), right +4 / left -4 (horizontal); each direction contributes 0 in the no-scroll branch. fd2_composite_battle_tile_map reads it as a dword and adds it directly (no scaling) into the background-blit source byte offset, together with param_1 and data_fd2_battle_compose_left_edge_clip_offset (@0x53AED), in every chapter branch that draws a background (animated 9/0x18/0x19/0x1C/0x1D, extra-wide parallax 0x11/0x15/0x16/0x1B, text-screen 0x17).
element_semantics: Single scalar: signed-or-unsigned 32-bit accumulator holding the active walk-step's cumulative sub-pixel scroll displacement as a flat byte offset into the background source buffer. Value range during a step: 0..6*0x720 (down) or 6*-0x720..0 (up) or 0..24 (right) or -24..0 (left); 0 at rest.
comment_original_issue: src comment called it the 'Y sub-pixel scroll accumulator' and stated all four directions add the per-frame delta '(0x720)', which is inaccurate: left/right add +/-4 (horizontal X delta), and the variable is axis-agnostic (single accumulator shared across all four directions, read as a flat source-buffer byte offset). The Ghidra plate was already accurate/complete on this point; the src comment lagged behind it.
notes: BSS, .object2, zero-init; read_memory @0x53AF5 returns all zeros (static image). Game-side WRITE xrefs from all four walk-step functions => not const.
